node.p: You are a hat. You are in a box.

p.wave: Ten minutes ago you were on a head.

look.label: Whose head were you on?
look.p: You remember a woman in a grey coat.
She takes the 23:59 train every Friday. It is the last train of the day.

p.pulse: You want to be on her head when the train leaves.

look.label: Look around.
look.p: This is the lost and found box. It is under the clerk's desk. Nobody is at the desk.
A mop leans against the box. You can reach it.
You cannot walk. But you can jump onto things. When you jump onto a thing, you become that thing. The old thing stays where it is.

node.p: You are a mop. You are wet.
You can move, but only slowly. The hat is on your handle.

look.label: Look around.
look.p: On the left there is a vending machine.
In front of you there is the ticket gate. It is closed. A guard is sleeping next to it. A pigeon is sitting on top of the gate.
The platform and the train are behind the gate.

node.choice: Go to the vending machine and jump onto it.

node.p: You are at the ticket gate. It is closed. It only opens for a badge.
The guard has a badge on his chest. He is asleep.

p.wave: A pigeon is sitting on top of the gate. You can reach it.

look.label: Bang the gate.
look.p: The guard moves a little. He thinks it is the wind. He goes back to sleep.

node.p: You are a vending machine. You cannot move. But you can make noise, and you have a screen. The hat is on top of you.
The guard is sleeping six metres away. You can see his badge.

look.label: Show ERROR 404 on the screen.
look.p: The screen shows ERROR 404. It blinks two times. Then it shows READY again.
The guard does not wake up.

node.p: A can falls out and rolls across the floor. The guard wakes up. He walks over and bends down to pick up the can.
His badge is right in front of you.
You are the guard. Your name is Denis. You are very tired.
The hat is on your head. You have a badge. It is time to check the platform. But your chair is right behind you.
The gate opens. The last train is waiting. Its doors are open.
Three people are standing on the platform: a woman in a grey coat, a man in a red hoodie, and a kid with a blue balloon.

p.pulse: The doors will close soon. You can jump one more time.

node.choice: Jump onto the woman in the grey coat.
Jump onto the man in the red hoodie.
Jump onto the kid with the balloon.

node.p: You are a pigeon. Everything is fast and simple.
The hat is on your back. You fly over the gate to the platform. Three people are standing under you.
You are too high to see faces. You can only see colors: something grey, something red, and something blue.
You land on the woman in the grey coat. She puts you straight without looking. She gets on the train.
The doors close. The train leaves.

c.name: hat
c.pulse: You are a hat on the right head. You are going home.

node.p: You land on the man in the red hoodie. He wakes up. He finds a hat on his head. He does not ask why.
He gets on the train. It is the right train, but the wrong head.

c.name: red
c.pulse: You are someone else's hat now.

node.p: You land on the kid. The kid screams with joy and lets go of the balloon.
The balloon goes up. The train leaves. The kid's mother takes you off and puts you in her bag.

p.c: Tomorrow you will go back to the box.

node.p: Denis sits down. The chair is very comfortable. He falls asleep.

p.wave: Behind his closed eyes, a train leaves.

p.c: You are a hat on a sleeping guard. The last train is gone.

node.p: It is 23:59. Far away, doors close and a train leaves. The platform lights go off one by one.
You are not on that train.

c.name: red
c.pulse: You are a hat. The box will still be here in the morning.
